description: Normative tool registry for reader and analyst bundles. Tools are backend data and action surfaces; Block[] is the separate response artifact contract.
design_rules: System selects tool bundle; model selects tools within the bundle.
Reader-only tools may access raw untrusted content; analyst-facing tools may not.
Tool inputs and outputs must validate against JSON Schema.
All outputs must be traceable to source refs or deterministic computations.
Side-effecting tools return pending actions unless policy explicitly auto-approves them.
Non-read-only tools remain write-intent policy boundaries even when approval_required is false.

tools.name: certified_financials
tools.description: Certified financial figures from SEC filings, planned and verified by the financial engine: every number shown is a checked result. Name the companies, the catalog metrics and the period when the question gives them, and the ask in your own words. income_statement is the whole statement (revenue, gross profit, operating income and net income, each with its margin); a line the question names alone, such as revenue or gross_margin, is that line's own metric. Statuses: published gives the figures; existing means an earlier attempt of this turn computed them and they cannot be shown again; clarification asks a question; declined and gap give the engine's reason; invalid_arguments, no_subject and unavailable as for the other tools.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: A company's business as its latest 10-K states it: the verbatim Item 1 claims (business.description, business.products, business.customers, business.competition), each with its filing, and each item's read state. no_business_claims: Item 1 was read in full and holds none. no_filing: no 10-K is on file for a subject. incomplete_read: no claim came back and an item was cut, unread or not found, a newer 10-K left it unread, or a limit left filers out, so it says nothing about what the filing states. Every result has a status. no_subject: a subject_ref names no stored company. invalid_arguments: an argument is not one this tool reads. unavailable: the database could not be read, which says nothing about what is on file.

tools.name: get_analyst_consensus
tools.description: Attributed analyst consensus (ADR 0006): the newest capture at most 7 days before the cutoff, each value labelled with its provider, field and capture date, and the mean recommendation score on a 1 to 5 scale, never a buy or sell word. no_consensus: no such capture holds a value. Every result has a status. no_subject: a subject_ref names no stored company. invalid_arguments: an argument is not one this tool reads. unavailable: the database could not be read, which says nothing about what is on file.

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: Standout findings in one company's own history, each checked by the financial engine over its latest fiscal years: operating margin at the highest or lowest of its last 10, cash conversion (operating cash flow / net income) at the lowest of its last 10, and stock-based compensation as a multiple of free cash flow at the highest of its last 5. A finding is a sentence filled from certified figures, which the answer cites. A check that cannot be sure is declined with its reason: incomplete_history (a year without a value), tag_change (a figure in its window filed under another concept), non_positive_base (a zero or negative denominator), engine_gap (another engine gap), or within_range (the latest year is not at the extreme). Statuses as for certified_financials.

subject_ref.description: A company the turn names, as its prompt lists it.

tools.name: get_non_gaap_history
tools.description: The GAAP to non-GAAP reconciliations of a company's stored earnings releases (Item 2.02 8-Ks) for its last 8 quarters on file, each quarter naming its release: diluted EPS GAAP, non-GAAP and their spread; operating income and, on the release's own revenue, the operating margin spread in percentage points; stock-based compensation added back and its share of non-GAAP net income. Each add-back category counts the quarters it appears in, and recurring means in 5 or more of the last 8: a count, never a judgment. no_releases: no release read for its reconciliation is on file. Every result has a status. no_subject: a subject_ref names no stored company. invalid_arguments: an argument is not one this tool reads. unavailable: the database could not be read, which says nothing about what is on file.

tools.name: get_price_performance
tools.description: Price return and last close of one to five companies over the week, month or year to date at the cutoff, from stored daily closes: each return runs from the last close before the period to the latest close every company has, on one price basis, and a split-adjusted return excludes dividends. Prices a company lacks are fetched first. no_prices: no return could be drawn from the stored prices, and reason says why. Every result has a status. invalid_arguments: an argument is not one this tool reads, or names a company the prompt does not list. unavailable: the stored prices could not be read, which says nothing about what is on file.
